title: Saturating natural subtraction
summary: Executes the emitted comparison and subtraction branches for staged natural operands, returning the encoded truncated difference while preserving the store and stack tail.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted natural subtraction region
Combined getters for both staged UInt64 operands
A continuation for the encoded natural difference
result: The program pushes UInt64.ofNat (left.toNat - right.toNat) and preserves the store, parameters, internal locals, and prior operand-stack tail.
